patch_description: Strengthen the exact diameter formulation with a feasibility-relaxed multi-pass SLSQP continuation. The first constrained solve identifies a contact graph; subsequent solves are reinitialized after exact minimum-distance rescaling and use progressively smaller lower-bound relaxation. This avoids SLSQP becoming prematurely stuck on tiny numerical lower-bound violations while preserving the scale-invariant ratio after each rescaling. Candidate solutions from every pass are evaluated with the true squared min/max ratio, so an imperfect solver termination cannot degrade the returned packing.
